versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill.yaml file from the project.
- Skill metadata (name, description) is now provided exclusively in SKILL.md.
- No functional or API changes in this version.

- Initial release of tool-call-retry v1.0.0.
- Adds automatic retry with exponential backoff for tool/API calls.
- Includes result format validation and custom error correction logic.
- Supports idempotency keys to prevent repeated side effects.
- Provides plug-and-play usage with minimal configuration required.
